items.title: 2 Reasons to Watch URI and 1 to Stay Cautious
items.summary: Since September 2021, the S&P 500 has delivered a total return of 70.6%. But one standout stock has more than doubled the market - over the past five years, United Rentals has surged 191% to $995.42 per share. Its momentum hasn’t stopped as it’s also gained 33.9% in the last six months thanks to its solid quarterly results, beating the S&P by 19.7%.
